transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what brings me in is... I had this thing happen at work. I'm a personal care aide, and we were in a staff meeting the other day. I just got really worked up, and I started acting out a whole fall-prevention drill right there in the middle of the room. I was moving chairs around, waving my arms all over the place to show them how to do it... and the thing is, I just couldn't seem to stop, even when folks kept telling me to sit down. So, my boss wanted me to come see a doctor.
Aside from that incident at the meeting, have you been feeling unusually energetic, talkative, or like your mind is racing for several days in a row?

Yeah, I have. On those high-energy days, I just can't seem to sit still. I'll tear through the house and clean all the closets, or I'll spend hours rewriting my care checklists for work. I even started planning a whole health fair for my church. I get going so fast that I start calling people before breakfast... it just feels like everything has to happen right then, you know?

During these high-energy periods, have you ever felt that your behavior was so out of control that it caused serious problems at your job, or did you ever have to be taken to the hospital because of it?

Well, I haven't had to go to the hospital, but... yeah, it definitely caused serious problems at my job. After that meeting, I was actually put on leave from the senior center. 

It's affecting things at home, too. I'm just not keeping up the way I used to, so my wife has had to start reminding me about doing my chores and making it to appointments. I don't know, it's just... it's made me pull back from my friends at church, too. I just worry a lot now about whether I can safely go back to doing caregiving work at all.
During these times when you feel so energized and fast-paced, have you ever seen or heard things that others couldn't, or felt like you had special powers or abilities that you don't normally have?

Well, yeah, actually. When I'm in one of those fired-up stretches... you know, when I'm only sleeping a few hours and making all those big plans... I was also hearing things. Like, I'd hear someone calling my name or giving me instructions, but there was nobody there. 

And... I don't know about special powers, but I did get this really strong feeling that my supervisor was out to get me. I was just so sure she was setting traps for me at work, trying to catch me doing something wrong so she could fire me. It felt completely real at the time.
